feature_comment: Implementation plan for #69 is ready. The work is split into task issues that cover the autonomous spec handoff flow, completion validation, and end-to-end verification against the merged design.

tasks.title: Implement Copilot-driven spec handoff fixture for issue #69
tasks.body:
## Objective
Update the spec E2E test setup so issue #69 can drive a GitHub Copilot spec handoff from the normal Autobot label flow.

## Scope
- Ensure the workflow posts the Copilot instruction comment with the configured trigger handle/token.
- Preserve the exact required design artifact path from the merged design contract.
- Keep the handoff PR metadata aligned with the issue reference and run-token traceability requirements.

## Acceptance notes
- The spec handoff can be started without manual intervention.
- The generated handoff keeps issue #69 and the run token traceable in PR metadata or comments.

tasks.title: Add completion polling checks for spec artifact finalization
tasks.body:
## Objective
Extend the completion logic so the spec phase only finishes when both the design artifact and `.autobot/output/spec.json` satisfy the merged design contract.

## Scope
- Validate the existence of `docs/69-autonomous-copilot-spec-e2e-test-20260916-152707/design.md`.
- Require non-placeholder design content before success is reported.
- Require `.autobot/output/spec.json` to contain a completed status and completion-ready metadata.
- Surface a clear blocked reason when one of the completion checks fails.

## Acceptance notes
- Partial completion does not advance the phase.
- Successful completion updates the phase output consistently with existing workflow contracts.
depends_on_titles: Implement Copilot-driven spec handoff fixture for issue #69

tasks.title: Verify autonomous spec E2E behavior end to end
tasks.body:
## Objective
Add or update end-to-end verification so the autonomous spec flow proves the merged design behavior from trigger through completion.

## Scope
- Exercise the label-driven entry point for issue #69.
- Assert that the required design file is created with substantive content.
- Assert that `.autobot/output/spec.json` is finalized with `status: completed`.
- Confirm issue linkage and run-token traceability remain visible in the resulting PR flow.

## Acceptance notes
- The test demonstrates that no manual PR comment or manual artifact edit is needed to complete the spec phase.
depends_on_titles: Add completion polling checks for spec artifact finalization
